**Summary:** The module is a large, observability-heavy generation loop for MTPLX with extensive env-var gating, runtime counters, and decode tracing, so a `summarize_generation_outputs` helper should slot in near the existing stats/diagnostics helpers and reuse the module's `dict[str, Any]` / `Sequence` typing conventions.

- The module already exposes `GenerationStats`-style dataclasses and `_generation_rate_fields`, so a summary helper should mirror that style (plain `dict[str, Any]`, `Sequence[GenerationOutput]`, no new dataclass) and compute p95 via `numpy.percentile` since `numpy` is already imported.
- Optional metrics (prefill TPS, decode TPS, peak memory) are frequently absent or zero in this codebase — e.g. `_generation_rate_fields` guards against zero elapsed time — so the helper must skip `None`/non-positive values rather than emit `inf`/`nan`, and must return a stable schema for the empty case.
- The module's env-gated tracing (`_DecodeTrace`, `_runtime_count`, `_attach_runtime_diagnostics`) shows the established pattern of keeping summaries JSON

cold_start.measurement_basis: first-64 DECODE STEPS, single-request (verify calls under DSpark, one token per step under --decode-mode ar; the cold window re-opens per request). Run the window A/B in --decode-mode ar.

switch_dispatch.note: cumulative over this AR DECODE pass. Per layer the host round-trip is one mx.eval(indices) barrier; allhit_fence_synced counts the SECOND blocking eval the shipped path pays per all-hit layer (switch_lean defers it -> allhit_fence_deferred). allhit_gather_qmm/all_hit is 3 (gate/up/down); switch_gather_qmm_total also includes split parts + prefill waves.

sinkhorn_engagement.note: cumulative over this arm (prefill + decode + census)

small_stages_engagement.note: cumulative over this arm (prefill + decode + census); the HEADLINE tok/s pass is UNTIMED so K35 is active there -- the timed stage-timing pass forces eager (recording guard)

kv_chunk_grow.note: cumulative over this arm; rows_copied is the STRATEGY's logical cost, compare vs the measured cache_append census stage

window_ring.note: cumulative over this arm; capacity = window_size + max_verify + slack (bounded); rows_copied flat-per-token == amortized O(1)

kv_bounded.note: cumulative over this arm; kv_realloc_<lane> == one-time prealloc (>1 growing == not preallocated-bounded); kv_inplace_writes_<lane> == O(new-rows) decode path; formula_matches_alloc exact iff kv_realloc_window == num_layers (no transient prefill grow)
